title: 04 — AWS and operations
tagline: Every AWS resource, setting and secret of the backend, how a deploy works, and how to run it day to day.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Every AWS resource, setting and secret of the backend, how a deploy works, and how to run it day to day.
All resources come from the CDK app in infra/ (B03). Region: ap-southeast-1.

blocks.html:
Security groupInFrom
Server80, 443anywhere
Database5432the server group only
  • No SSH port: shell access goes through SSM Session Manager.
  • No NAT gateway (~$32/month saved): the server has a public IP; the database needs no internet.

Diagram: 80, 443 → Elastic IP → VPC (2 zones) → public subnets → EC2 t4g.small, caddy · api · worker → isolated subnets (no internet) → RDS Postgres 16 → 5432, TLS → HTTPS → S3 → HTTPS → ECR · SSM · Secrets Manager · CloudWatch

blocks.html:
TriggerTarget
Push to mainstaging
Tag v* (e.g. v1.0.0)production, after a reviewer approves the production environment
  • Rollback: run the Deploy workflow's SSM step with an older commit, or on the server sitelog-deploy <older-commit>. Migrations are forward only, so a rollback must work with the newer schema (add columns, never rename or drop in the same release).

DatabaseRDS automated backups + point-in-time restore7 days staging, 14 days prod

Infrastructureinfra/ in git—

blocks.html:
TaskCommand
Shell on the serveraws ssm start-session --target <instance-id> (needs the Session Manager plugin)
Containerscd /opt/sitelog && sudo docker compose ps
Last API logssudo docker compose logs --tail 100 api
Restart the APIsudo docker compose restart api
Deploy a commit by handsudo /usr/local/bin/sitelog-deploy <commit>
OS updatessudo dnf upgrade -y && sudo reboot (monthly; containers come back by themselves)
Psql into RDSFrom the server: sudo docker compose run --rm api node -e "…", or a temporary postgres:16 container with the URL from secrets.env
Stop staging to save moneyaws ec2 stop-instances --instance-ids <id> and aws rds stop-db-instance --db-instance-identifier <id> (RDS restarts itself after 7 days)
